Name: Ellie's Reaper Scythe
Author: MilqueToastly
Description:
Inspired by my Former Grim Reaper Farmer!

A new sword that looks like a scythe, it can be bought from Krobus's Shop (though I wont stop you from using a cheat menu)

It's 50,000 Gold and should have similar stats to the Galaxy Sword (if you have any recommendations for different stats please tell me) 


WARNING: it can sometimes get confused with your grass scythe, so be careful if you have both in your inventory.


this is my first mod so please be patient with me
